actor_awards.notes: She made history by becoming the first African American to win an Academy Award (Best Supporting Actress for 'Gone with the Wind'). Despite frequent typecasting in maid roles, she infused her characters with wit, dignity, and independence. She received two stars on the Hollywood Walk of Fame (Radio and Motion Pictures).

filmography.title: Gone with the Wind
filmography.role_description: The fiercely loyal, outspoken, and fiercely protective head slave of the O'Hara family who acts as a maternal figure to Scarlett.
filmography.plot: A manipulative woman and a roguish man conduct a turbulent romance during the American Civil War and Reconstruction periods.

filmography.title: Since You Went Away
filmography.role_description: The devoted housekeeper who stays with the Hilton family despite their financial struggles during World War II.
filmography.plot: With her husband away at war, a woman struggles to keep her family together and support the war effort on the home front.

filmography.title: In This Our Life
filmography.role_description: A mother whose son is falsely accused of a hit-and-run crime by a selfish socialite.
filmography.plot: A young woman runs off with her sister's husband, leading to tragedy and a hit-and-run accident where she frames a Black youth.
filmography.awards: National Board of Review: Top Ten Films

filmography.title: Alice Adams
filmography.role_description: A sassy, gum-chewing maid hired for a disastrous dinner party intended to impress a wealthy suitor.
filmography.plot: A socially ambitious girl from a working-class family lies about her background to impress a wealthy young man.

filmography.title: Show Boat
filmography.role_description: The warm-hearted cook on the showboat, partnered with Paul Robeson's character, Joe.
filmography.plot: The lives and loves of the performers on a Mississippi riverboat over the course of several decades.

filmography.title: Nothing Sacred
filmography.role_description: A briefly seen but memorable resident of Warsaw, Vermont, contributing to the town's eccentric portrayal.
filmography.plot: A reporter tries to redeem his reputation by exploiting the story of a Vermont woman who thinks she is dying of radium poisoning.

filmography.title: The Little Colonel
filmography.role_description: A loyal family servant who tries to bring an estranged grandfather and his granddaughter together.
filmography.plot: A young girl tries to mend the rift between her mother and her gruff, Confederate veteran grandfather.

filmography.title: Saratoga
filmography.role_description: The personal maid and confidante to Jean Harlow's character.
filmography.plot: A bookie and the daughter of a horse breeder clash and fall in love at the races.

filmography.title: The Great Lie
filmography.role_description: The dedicated and protective maid of Bette Davis's character, providing emotional support.
filmography.plot: A man's invalid marriage to a concert pianist leads to a complex web of lies involving his former fiancée and a secret baby.
filmography.awards: Oscar: Win – Best Supporting Actress (Mary Astor)

filmography.title: They Died with Their Boots On
filmography.role_description: The loyal maid to Libby Custer, maintaining a warm relationship with her mistress.
filmography.plot: A highly fictionalized account of the life of George Armstrong Custer, from his arrival at West Point to his death at the Little Bighorn.

filmography.title: Song of the South
filmography.role_description: The warm cook and maid who provides comfort to young Johnny at the Southern plantation.
filmography.plot: A young boy visits a Southern plantation and learns life lessons from the stories told by Uncle Remus.

filmography.title: The Male Animal
filmography.role_description: The outspoken and observant maid in a college professor's household.
filmography.plot: A college professor's academic freedom and his marriage are threatened when a former football star returns to town.

filmography.title: Thank Your Lucky Stars
filmography.role_description: Appears in a musical number performing 'Ice Cold Katie' in this wartime morale-booster.
filmography.plot: A theatrical producer stages a charity show featuring a cavalcade of Warner Bros. stars performing musical numbers.

filmography.title: George Washington Slept Here
filmography.role_description: The sassy cook who deals with the chaos of a couple renovating a dilapidated farmhouse.
filmography.plot: A couple buys a run-down farmhouse in Pennsylvania because George Washington supposedly slept there, leading to numerous headaches.

filmography.title: Blonde Venus
filmography.role_description: An early, uncredited role as a maid serving Marlene Dietrich's character.
filmography.plot: A cabaret singer becomes the mistress of a wealthy man to pay for her husband's medical treatment.
filmography.awards: National Board of Review: Top Ten Films

filmography.title: I'm No Angel
filmography.role_description: One of Mae West's maids, part of a famous scene where West sings 'I Found a New Way to Go to Town'.
filmography.plot: A carnival dancer tries to change her life by moving to the city and targeting wealthy men.

filmography.title: The Mad Miss Manton
filmography.role_description: The sharp-tongued maid to a wealthy socialite who leads a group of debutantes in solving a murder.
filmography.plot: A flighty socialite and her debutante friends discover a body and decide to solve the murder themselves, to the annoyance of the police.

filmography.title: Affectionately Yours
filmography.role_description: A maid caught in the romantic crossfire between a reporter and his ex-wife.
filmography.plot: A foreign correspondent tries to win back his ex-wife before she marries another man.

filmography.title: Maryland
filmography.role_description: A supportive figure in a drama centered around horse racing in the South.
filmography.plot: A mother forbids her son to ride horses after her husband is killed in a hunting accident, but he rides secretly.

filmography.title: Judge Priest
filmography.role_description: A maid in the household of a tolerant Kentucky judge, acting alongside Will Rogers.
filmography.plot: A tolerant judge in post-Civil War Kentucky tries to maintain peace and justice in his town while dealing with his nephew's romance.

filmography.title: Zenobia
filmography.role_description: A maid in a comedy where an elephant becomes attached to a country doctor.
filmography.plot: A doctor cures a carnival elephant, which then follows him everywhere, causing chaos in his life.

filmography.title: The Shopworn Angel
filmography.role_description: The maid and confidante to a cynical showgirl who falls for a naive soldier.
filmography.plot: A cynical showgirl meets a naive soldier about to ship out to World War I, and they develop a touching relationship.

filmography.title: Family Honeymoon
filmography.role_description: The capable maid who manages the household while a newlywed couple brings their children on their honeymoon.
filmography.plot: A widow with three children marries a professor, and circumstances force them to bring the kids along on their honeymoon.

filmography.title: Mickey
filmography.role_description: A housekeeper in this comedy-drama about a tomboy trying to reform.
filmography.plot: A tomboy girl causes trouble in a small town but tries to mend her ways.

filmography.title: Janie
filmography.role_description: A maid who deals with the teenage antics of the title character.
filmography.plot: A teenager throws a party for soldiers while her parents are out of town, leading to chaos.
